recommendation.training: scratch1500 seed42 env6144, conditional on measured remaining time permitting selection and independent validation
recommendation.basis: Conservative utility judgment combining preservation of measured F10 behavior, fewer unvalidated simultaneous changes, and interpretability. It is not an estimated expected-score optimum.
recommendation.b2_review: Defensible as a deliberately broader exploration choice, but evidence does not establish higher expected score than S5. Do not infer that restoring F10 tracking preserves a beneficial B1 cost bundle.
recommendation.conditional_reconsideration: Before launching the single new training, use preserved B1 checkpoints and current-runtime C0/F10 screening. Only a concrete B1 fixed-scenario advantage relevant to transitions/push/ordinary yaw can supply new support for retaining its cost bundle. Do not choose from raw training reward.

reward_algebra.limit: Per-state reward algebra only. Global reward scaling need not produce identical PPO updates because critic/value scales, entropy weighting and optimization interact.

candidate_comparison.pro: Preserves F10 XY:yaw ratio and keeps action/acceleration smoothing while changing the body/torque/air balance; not an exact S1/R1 duplicate.
candidate_comparison.con: Four cost-related changes are bundled. B1 matched-terrain late tracking/contact worsened, and vertical/roll-pitch proxies rose. No isolated beneficial B1 cost effect established.
candidate_comparison.utility: Exploration breadth, low causal resolution, unproven expected-score advantage.

candidate_comparison.pro: Keeps F10 tracking, body-motion costs, air, action and acceleration weights; changes one coefficient.
candidate_comparison.con: Torque restriction has not been identified as the cause of the VX tail; more permitted effort may worsen contact or have no effect.
candidate_comparison.utility: Best conservative single-run diagnostic among these candidates; improvement remains unproven.

candidate_comparison.pro: Changes axis preference without increasing the sum of maximum positive tracking coefficients.
candidate_comparison.con: Reduces yaw coefficient despite F10's strong yaw advantage and ordinary yaw contribution. A previous linear3/yaw1.5 short run had push failures; not an exact counterexample to AX but a caution.
candidate_comparison.utility: Deprioritized for this single new run; coefficient sum does not preserve expected reward or gradient mass.

falsification: Do not promote any candidate on training reward, curriculum level, or B1 early-learning advantage alone.
Reject selection if any prespecified scenario survival nonregression gate fails.
Require whole-window tracking improvement under matched evaluation; short-window VX gains cannot offset unreported ordinary-yaw regression.
Track full-window VX and critical-scenario caps, plus transition/start/push VX tail and ordinary yaw as diagnostics.
Independent validation reset seeds must be disjoint from checkpoint-selection seeds. These are not independent training seeds.
Exact model SHA, iteration, params and full-window/event coverage must identify each evaluated checkpoint.
If the four-hour reserve for independent validation and artifact recovery cannot be retained, do not launch an additional or second training.
execution_sequence_advice: First screen preserved B1 600/1000/1499 alongside C0/F10 with the same current runtime; this phase is selection, not final validation.
Lock one fresh candidate and stopping/selection rules before new training.
Preserve exact intermediate and final checkpoints despite provided train.py postprocessing; do not let the earlier model1499-original-path deletion bug invalidate selection.
Select on one fixed screening protocol, then validate the selected exact checkpoint on disjoint reset seeds with reference policies.
Keep training to one run; prioritize evidence completion over spending the entire budget on iterations.

primary_sources.relevance: Squared body-motion/torque/action penalties and exponential tracking are different quantities. Coefficient sizes alone do not identify dominant control limits.
Removing air-time removes a landing-time shaping term, not a verified foot-height or rapid-contact controller.
Tradeoff between excessive penalties and unnatural low-penalty motion; staged cost curriculum is a separate method not implemented by this static candidate.

historical_manifest_warning: The old candidate manifest lists trained:false even for S1/R1; actual execution/result status comes from final_analysis.txt, not stale proposal fields.
